Explore means to journey through a region, city, or natural area with the primary goal of discovering new sights and experiences. Unlike sightseeing, exploration emphasises curiosity-driven movement, allowing you to wander off the beaten path and actively engage with the local environment. Whether you are navigating hidden urban laneways or trekking through remote wilderness, exploring is all about uncovering what lies beyond your normal boundaries
